description: the same caching server as leases.json, but on a share carrying SMB2_SHAREFLAG_FORCE_LEVELII_OPLOCK: every grant caps to a read cache, so exclusive/batch and W/H leases are never handed out and the break lifecycle runs entirely at LEVEL_II / R. (WPTS ShareForceLevel2 is 112 of the 156 green oplock cases.)
